answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in memorizing vast amounts of knowledge and applying it across various applications, such as question answering, dialogue systems, and code generation.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include generated responses to factual queries, such as "The 2010 Winter Paralympics is located in Vancouver", after in-context knowledge editing.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate editing performance using standard metrics introduced by . Edit Success Rate (ESR) measures how often the LLM outputs the correct edited object (target_new); Retention Rate (RR) measures whether the original object (target_true) is preserved on unrelated neighborhood prompts; and Paraphrase Consistency (PC) checks agreement on paraphrased in-scope prompts.
